checks.reference_match: Where Sol is visible, compare the COMPLETE original mascot at a similar size: silhouette, tip/lobes, red/orange/cream contour paths and widths, face/eye proportions and limbs. Do not pass a generic flame character. Where Sol is off-screen, compare the planned setting/props and approved frame pair without requiring him. Keep user design approval separate.
checks.eyes: Both original oval eyes stay identical and open throughout: same dark navy, shape, size, spacing and placement. No expressive morphs, squinting, widening, closing, eye whites, highlights or added eyebrows. Judge performance through body pose and gestures.
checks.flame_and_limbs: Match the original flat whole silhouette and all nested contour paths, layer widths and proportions. Retain source red foot nubs and short arm shapes. Reject sculpted/inflated volume, a widened or raised cream mask, a new shaded lower rim, or remodeled hand/foot shapes. Painted texture cannot redesign the source geometry.
checks.framing_and_props: Match the active scene first/last crops, camera, required character/prop counts and physical attachments. Apply only episode-specific requirements; an earlier episode does not supply mandatory props for a new story.
checks.contacts_and_action: Supported feet and hands, correct weight transfer, one planned action per beat, no skating, floating, extra steps, bobbing or repeated gestures.
checks.mechanical_direction: Inspect consecutive real frames for the planned direction, rigid connections when present, and causal order of physical events. Do not infer correct movement or causality from a prompt, label, endpoint or successful decode.
checks.object_continuity: Maintain the identity and count of planned objects. A tracking mark, when present, stays attached to the same object and cannot jump, multiply or fade to fake movement. Fire may flicker or fuel may glow only as the approved action requires.
checks.start_end_states: The actual first/last footage frames match the user-approved stills and the required resulting pose/mechanism state.
checks.performance_and_timing: Source-faithful pose/gesture performance, unchanged eyes and proportions, Narrator eyeline when Sol is visible, and planned physical action/ending holds at actual timestamps. Sol can be off-screen where planned.
checks.clean_footage: No unintended text, logos, props, narrator on screen, audio or other generation artifacts. Inspect all frames, not only the endpoints.
checks.painted_art_style: Visible soft gouache-like brushwork, layered color, subtle paper texture and expressive painted shapes cover Sol, props and environment consistently. Forms use light/color without inked outlines. Compare the selected graphic references. A smooth logo-like mascot with only a grain overlay fails even if its geometry is correct. Preserve the source character and clear mechanical contacts through the paint.

review_rules: A technical probe or contact-sheet extraction is preparation, never a visual approval.
The user must see and explicitly approve BOTH first and last stills before video generation. The generator cannot approve them on the user's behalf.
A dedicated reviewer inspects actual evidence independently of generation. Every required check needs pass, fail or uncertain with evidence.
Fail, uncertain, missing evidence, missing user frame approval or a changed input blocks production approval.
Reviewing a clip does not authorize another paid generation. Preserve rejected takes.
Character geometry and painted art style must each pass. Approval of one does not establish the other or approve the complete frame pair.
